feeds.title: Becoming Minimalist
feeds.description: Becoming Minimalist inspires others to journey toward simple living. Own less, live more. We are dedicated to rational minimalism and discovering what that uniquely means for us. And the more who are introduced to this life-changing message, the better! Because we're all just trying to make the most of this journey called life.

feeds.title: The Seana Method Blog
feeds.description: This blog features expert advice on how to organize your clutter, paperwork, travel, teenagers, spaces, and calendar, as well as efficiency and productivity. The Seana Method offers professional organizing services, including clutter elimination, floor planning, paperwork systems, and time management coaching.

feeds.title: Peace of Mind Organizing Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Janine Adams - a certified professional organizer based in St. Louis, and the creator of Peace of Mind Organizing®. If you're ready to de­clutter with a purpose and add more ease to your life, you've found the right blog - and you've found the right company.

feeds.title: Simply Organized Blog
feeds.description: Samantha Pregenzer, CPO and Founder of Simply Organized in Danville, CA, merges beauty with function in professional organizing. A Certified Professional Organizer from the Bay Area, she shares real-life home organization tips, decluttering insights, and inviting space designs on her blog, embodying her passion for simply organized living.

feeds.title: Clutterbug
feeds.description: I'm Cas! Recovering Super Slob turned Organizing Expert, and I can't wait to help you transform your home and life too! I'm now on a mission to spread the Clutterbug® Organizing Philosophy and help other families who struggle with disorganization and clutter.

feeds.title: A Tidy Mind Blog
feeds.description: Do you need decluttering tips & advice on organising your house and life? Feeling overwhelmed & stressed? Be inspired to simplify your home and find joy & calm. Founder Kate Ibbotson is a professional declutterer, organiser & life coach.

feeds.title: Clean Mama » Decluttering
feeds.description: I'm Becky! I'm so glad you've joined me here at Clean Mama. For many years, I've been helping people just like you bring joy and calm into their homes. If you feel like you've tried so many times to get your home in order and you're ready to give up, I'm here to tell you that you really CAN have a clean home and a busy life.

feeds.title: Filling the Jars
feeds.description: Decluttering + Intentional Living for the Overwhelmed Overthinker. This is where I inspire you - the overwhelmed overthinker - to declutter, to live intentionally, and to Build Your Best Life. Learn to simplify, organize, get things DONE, and create opportunities for a better life and income.

feeds.title: The Simplicity Habit Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Julianna. I'm a wife, mama, and professional declutterer. I'm passionate about living a life full of purpose and intention. Join me on this journey of simplifying & creating margin so you can say yes to the great. Get the most up-to-date information, free weekly tips on decluttering and simplifying your home & life.

feeds.title: Get Organized HQ Blog
feeds.description: Get Organized HQ is your go-to source for step-by-step, easy-to-implement resources for organizing a more peaceful, joy-filled life. No matter what your home looks like or what your schedule includes working, parenting, hobbies, or more the system that will help you get organized is the one you can stick with.

feeds.title: Happy Organized Life Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my little slice of peace and quiet. I am a wife and stay-at-home mom to seven children, and this is where I share tips and practical help for decluttering, organizing, and intentional living.

feeds.title: Simply Well Balanced
feeds.description: Tips on decluttering, family-friendly recipes, parenting advice, and tons of fun ideas and activities for kids. Lauren Tingley helps moms to create balance and find joy in motherhood by sharing tips to simplify homemaking using practical strategies to implement a minimalistic lifestyle.

feeds.title: Simply + Fiercely Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer. Speaking of living simply, I'm a reformed shopaholic turned minimalist. I believe that clearing out the clutter is a vital part of creating a life you love. I took control of my life and cleared out the clutter. I started being honest with myself; listening to my heart, doing more of what I love, and learning to let go of all the rest.

feeds.title: Clutter Healing Blog
feeds.description: Clutter Healing fosters emotional, physical, and spiritual release for clients, guiding them to let go of what no longer serves them. Through compassionate education and non-judgmental support, they teach the art of being organized, not just getting organized. By aligning spaces with values and promoting conscious consumption, Clutter Healing transforms homes and lives, promoting well-being and harmony.

feeds.title: The Decluttering Corner Blog
feeds.description: Decluttering is about building systems that keep clutter under control and leave space for you to live life to its fullest. I can teach you how to make ADHD your decluttering superpower.

feeds.title: Mindful Decluttering & Organizing Blog
feeds.description: We write about decluttering, organizing, mindfulness, time awareness, and more. Simplify your life with comprehensive decluttering and organizing support. In addition to step-by-step decluttering support and guidance, you will benefit from tools and strategies for increasing time awareness and productivity.

feeds.title: Life with Less Mess Blog
feeds.description: Do you struggle to relax when your home is a mess? This organization blog from a mom, teacher, and professional organizer can help!

feeds.title: The Clutter Fairy Blog
feeds.description: The Clutter Fairy offers organizing services and ongoing support to help clients clear their clutter and focus on what they really want. We offer free assessments, one-on-one appointments, meetups, webcasts, and videos full of helpful organizing advice.

feeds.title: ClutterBGone Blog
feeds.description: Free expert tips to help you organize every part of your home, your business, and your life, from Canadian professional organizer Linda Vanderkolk. When you hire ClutterBGone, you'll receive a complete transformation of the areas that cause you grief and frustration, maximization of your space, and newfound freedom with that weight lifted right off your shoulders.

feeds.title: Tidymalism
feeds.description: Tidymalism is devoted to navigating a middle ground between minimalism and maximalism with style. Lighter living, home organisation, decluttering, smart spending, and managing life alone as a single professional.

feeds.title: Laura Noelle Blog
feeds.description: Transform your living spaces, slow down family life, and simplify emotional balance: declutter your home with heart! Living simply and naturally is a fulfilling and attainable way to thrive!

feeds.title: Happy Simple Mom
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Brooke. I am passionate about providing practical solutions for clearing clutter in your home and simplifying your life. My mission is to help you find order, so you can focus on spending more time doing what you love. Gain control over your home and life, find more joy, and even save money along the way! A simpler way of living is possible.

feeds.title: Living with Margins Blog
feeds.description: Practical advice for busy women who feel overwhelmed by the pressures of life. Living with Margins is a blog encouraging busy Christian women to simplify life and practise self-care.

feeds.title: Uncluttered Simplicity
feeds.description: Essential tips and guides to declutter, organize and simplify your home and life. Experience more joy and less stress! For over 5 years we have been encouraging, empowering, and equipping busy women with home organization ideas to inspire them to create a calm and organized home.

feeds.title: Less Stuff Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lisa Cole, a self-employed single mum who likes making things, including a mess. Find gentle ways to gain control of your belongings.

feeds.title: A Bowl Full of Lemons
feeds.description: Organizing, cleaning, budgeting, home keeping and decorating inspiration! A Bowl Full of Lemons is a growing community of people who aspire to get their lives in order.

feeds.title: Ask Anna Moseley Blog
feeds.description: Ask Anna is a blog that specializes answering readers toughest cleaning, organizing and decorating questions. It also shares lots of DIY, organizing and decorating tutorials.

feeds.title: Organized Home
feeds.description: Cynthia Ewer is the publisher of OrganizedHome.com, an information resource for home organization and management.

feeds.title: Becoming UnBusy Blog
feeds.description: Reset and design a simple life. There's a reason why decluttering your physical space feels so good. It declutters your mind, clears your energy field, and creates space for new and exciting things to come your way. The UnBusy Collective is a membership and private community (off of social) that brings women together to unclutter, reset and make space for a simple life.

feeds.title: It's My Favorite Day
feeds.description: I'm Kristal! My desire is to help you clear space in your home & life to make room for what matters most. This is a place to find not only tips for simplifying your life, but encouragement, inspiration, and motivation to make today your favorite day.

feeds.title: Neat Little Nest Blog
feeds.description: Neat Little Nest is a home organization company whose mission is to help people create the beautifully organized spaces they've always dreamed about.

feeds.title: Declutter Go Blog
feeds.description: Sometimes all you need is a little nudge to get moving! Declutter Go uses Newton's first law of motion to snap you out of inaction, giving you a single task to stay focused on at one time. Once you start, you're on a roll!

feeds.title: Caroline Solomon Blog
feeds.description: Tips and tricks for decluttering and organizing your home. My goal is to help you create functional, elegant systems that blend organization with style. I will fully equip you with a space in which everything has its place, but doesn't scream, 'I'm an organizing bin!' By clearing out the clutter, you'll feel more content, relaxed and at ease at home and beyond.

feeds.title: Suzy Kell Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Suzy, I help couples declutter effectively together so they can clean less, hug more, and live with so much more freedom. So, if your home office has become Jurassic Park or the thought of having a guest stay in your cramped spare room makes your heart race, you're in the right place.

feeds.title: Diana Rene - The Decluttered Mom Blog
feeds.description: My name is Diana Rene, and I have spent the last several years mastering the practice of 'minimal-ish living' in the home. I have figured out the way to purge ruthlessly and efficiently and to then organize systems and routines in the home so that the newfound freedom and joy can be held onto. I so desperately want these things for you too, girl!

feeds.title: Life Is Organized
feeds.description: I'm Mridu. I help mom business owners conquer their demands and distractions, so they stop drowning and start commanding their time and energy.

feeds.title: Your House Machine
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rebecca! I live in the Pacific Northwest. Here, on this blog you'll find me creating a peaceful, organized home requires systems--not just one-off organizing projects. I explore how to build and run systems in your house, leveraging Japanese manufacturing practices, design, and psychology.

feeds.title: Simple Lionheart Life
feeds.description: A simple living blog featuring minimalism, decluttering, simplifying, intentional living, organizing, minimalism with kids, capsule wardrobes, mindfulness, and self-care. Authored by Melissa Russell, a thirty-something, stay-at-home mom of three.

feeds.title: Decluttering School Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sarah, creator of Decluttering School, formerly known as Early Bird Mom, mom to four of the most rambunctious boys you will ever meet.Upbeat encourager of overwhelmed women, Sarah Mueller founded and authors the blog Decluttering School, which offers guidance on decluttering and organizing.

feeds.title: Practigal Blog
feeds.description: Practigal Blog is a lifestyle blog focused on simplifying, organizing, and prioritizing everything that matters. This site is filled with tips and advice on simplifying, organizing, and prioritizing your life. You'll find information on space-saving hacks, travel, and planning. I started this blog to save you time with what I have already learned. I've wasted enough time for both of us through disorganization and a lack of planning. My love for minimalism, joy, and peace will shine through this blog.

feeds.title: SpaceClear Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie Bennett Vogt is a leading space clearing expert, teacher, and author of 5 books and 4 online courses. She brings 40 years of teaching experience to SpaceClear, the practice she founded in 1996 to help homes and people come into balance.

feeds.title: The Abundantly Minimal Blog
feeds.description: My name is Sarah Settanni, and I am an educator and minimalist on a mission to help people live their best lives with less.
